featureApi.snippet:
export interface CreateSoDetailCommand {
    itemId: string
    originalQty: number
    netWeightKg?: number | null
    uom?: string | null
    lotId?: string | null
}

export interface CreateSaleOrderCommand {
    orderType: string
    ownerId: string
    requestedDate?: string | null
    notes?: string | null
    details: CreateSoDetailCommand[]
}

export interface UpdateSaleOrderCommand {
    orderType: string
    ownerId: string
    requestedDate?: string | null
    notes?: string | null

}

featureSchema.snippet:
export const saleOrderDetailSchema = z.object({
    id: z.string().optional(),
    itemId: z.string(),
    itemName: z.string().optional().nullable(),
    originalQty: z.number(),
    uom: z.string().optional().nullable(),
    netWeightKg: z.number().optional().nullable(),
    lotId: z.string().optional().nullable(),
    lotNumber: z.string().optional().nullable(),
})

export type SaleOrderDetail = z.infer<typeof saleOrderDetailSchema>

actionDialog.description: SaleOrdersActionDialog with useFieldArray - follow PurchaseOrder pattern
actionDialog.keyPattern: useFieldArray({ control, name: 'details' }) with SelectField(itemId), NumberField(originalQty), SelectField(uom), NumberField(netWeightKg), SelectField(lotId)
